metrics.method: Full history 2026-03-23 to 2026-09-10, 843 records (825 messages + 18 service events); client side = alias 'Vale' from config/clients.yaml, everyone else = our side (all senders appear in config/team.yaml; no vendor chat team on this account). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?' (56). unanswered_over_24h = distinct client questions/requests with no SUBSTANTIVE answer inside 24h, read by hand (7); of those, 5 were never answered at all: 'Should I change my password?' (Jul 28, 45d), 'Can you guys tell me what you have on him on your notes ?' (Aug 7, 35d), 'Anything I should know before the live? How many minutes and what he wants?' (Aug 3), 'Was a call booked for today ?' (Aug 7), and which of her two Snapchat accounts we want admin on (Sep 10). Median lag from the start of a client burst to the next team message is 0.6h across 124 bursts (p75 13h, p90 21h); 7 bursts went >24h. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive messages from our side = 5.2d (May 5 -> May 10; also Aug 20 -> Aug 25); the longest stretch with no NON-templated outbound is 9 days (Aug 20 -> Aug 29, broken only by an automated leak report). promises_made counts explicit forward-looking commitments by our side ('I'll send X', 'we can get them scheduled', a booked call, a stated cadence); kept = evidence of delivery in-chat; lapsed = no delivery and no further mention; the remaining 4 are pending or unverifiable from the log.

top_fix: Make closing a loop in writing someone's actual job. Give the account lead a standing weekly close-out obligation posted into the client chat: every paid fan order and every promise made in the chat gets one dated line — delivered / scheduled for X / not started — plus a one-line performance number. Nothing on this account failed for lack of contact; five of our people appeared in the last fortnight alone. It failed because no commitment on this account has ever had a required end-state: the $2,000 custom was found by accident three months late, the sexting template is 45 days overdue, the vault purge 40 days unconfirmed, two payments sit unreconciled, and her one unanswered security question is 45 days old. A weekly written ledger would have caught all five before the client did.
